notes.title: 0.9 Playtest
notes.content:
New features:
Added damage numbers
Added critical strike
Added left-shift to fast forward time (proper button for it is coming)

Changed Upgrades:
Rusty shiv now gives crit chance instead of +1 damage
nerfed trowel to only affect crops (now excluding bamboo and lantana but actually still affects hedge)

New Upgrades:
- Sleeping Potion (double flail stun duration)
- Morel (gnomes +1 pop use, +1 damage)
- Chanterelle (gnomes +1 damage when next to tree)
- deathcap (2x goblins spawned)
- gold top (gnomes 50% xp gain, -1 pop use)
- wolf head (gnomes +1 damage when alone)
- wolf heart (gnomes +10% crit when alone)
- wolf claw (gnomes -20% cooldown when alone)
- gumboots (gnomes can go on swamp tiles)
- palantir (wizard +1 range)
- lotus (spreading swamp crop)

Bug fixes:
fix continue after dying bug
fix flickering red X
Lazy pathing bug fixed when goblins would cut through big mazes

Other changes:
revised some tooltips
changed desert sapper distribution
added wishlist buttons
added discord entry to main menu
changed idle gnome warning to be red
increased stun fatiguing, increased stun duration

notes.title: Playtest 0.7
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Economy Overhaul
[*] Beans now produce fertile soil at the end of a day
[*] Change level up to allow you to hide and view map
[*] Gnomes and Goblin tents got UI and SFX updates
[*] Idle Gnomes are now more clearly highlighted.
[*] Dynamite no longer works with recycling bin
[*] Hose can now destroy bamboo, leaving behind swamp
[*] Pumpkins could be planted on regular tiles, they can now only be planted on or moved to a fertile tile
[/list]
